title: Kagamine Rin — A Tomboyish Melody〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The front entrance is over there and this corridor takes me to the teachers' office...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's so cool! This whole SEKAI's just one big school!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But Miku-P and the others don't really seem like teachers... Come to think of it, there's no one like that here...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That means...
I can do whatever I want?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hahaha♪
Nobody will get mad at me for running around!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hm? That sound...
Oh, could it be...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's see. It sounded like it was coming from this classroom...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Time for a quick peek!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Oh, it's Luka and MEIKO! Also...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Miku-P too... Wait, are those the girls that created this SEKAI?!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Okay. I'd only heard stories, but it looks like it's really them...!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Man... I really want to just burst in and say, Yay! Let's do a session together!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (But they all seem so focused on what they're doing. I'd feel bad interrupting them...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (But still...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (They sound amazing...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I wish I could put on a cool session like the one they're in now!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Oh, I can try copying them♪ Start with a finger slide on bass... Voom...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Hey! Not bad, if I don't say so myself♪)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (That last synth part was really cool too. Hehe. I'll try that next.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(And then, guitar!
That solo was so awesome!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(Let's see, I think it went like...
Twangy♪ Twang♪ Twaaang♪)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Hmm... What's a cool way for me to play that part? I can stand like this and strum by going...)
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(Twang♪ Lalala♪
Twang Twang Twaang♪)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Yeah! Look at me, the rock-n-roller...!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wah?!
M-M-Miku-P?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rin? What are you doing out there?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Uh oh... Hehehe...
Busted...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Nooo! They all left already?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I thought I was gonna get to meet them...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They'll be back for practice tomorrow, so don't worry.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's good then...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I really liked your air guitar just now, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! W-Were you watching?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Only a little bit.
It looked like you were having so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But wanting to move to the rhythm is understandable. A good performance definitely has that effect.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, they do. Especially the way the girls have been playing lately.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Exactly! That's it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I really really wanna do a session with them...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Since we're on the subject, did you have a particular instrument already in mind?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me? For starters, I was thinking the synth!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I like how it can play so many different kinds of sounds!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wait, for starters?
Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'll go on guitar after that!
I love the sound it makes when you strum♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And after that...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin, does this mean you plan on playing everything...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Of course♪
I'll maximize the fun I have that way☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I know exactly how you feel!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: See☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. This place just keeps becoming livelier and more vibrant.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I can see that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait until tomorrow.
